cards.name: Yanma
cards.description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

cards.name: Grookey
cards.description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

cards.name: Thwackey
cards.description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

cards.name: Rillaboom
cards.description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

cards.name: Gossifleur
cards.description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

cards.name: Eldegoss
cards.description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

cards.name: Zarude
cards.description: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

cards.name: Reshiram
cards.description: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

cards.name: Yanmega
cards.description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.description: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

cards.name: Buizel
cards.description: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

cards.name: Floatzel
cards.description: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

cards.name: Manaphy
cards.description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

cards.name: Volcanion
cards.description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

cards.name: Chewtle
cards.description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

cards.name: Drednaw
cards.description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

cards.name: Cramorant
cards.description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

cards.name: Snom
cards.description: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

cards.name: Celebi
cards.description: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

cards.name: Frosmoth
cards.description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.description: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

cards.name: Galarian Weezing
cards.description: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

cards.name: Spinarak
cards.description: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

cards.name: Yveltal
cards.description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

cards.name: Nickit
cards.description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

cards.name: Thievul
cards.description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

cards.name: Cufant
cards.description: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

cards.name: Indeedee
cards.description: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.description: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.description: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.description: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.
